phase: G4A-2R Phase 2: unified posture configuration with server-validated angles

notes.entry_point: All named postures (including the episode initial posture) now come from the unified profile; arm_spec.initial_positions is only a compatibility fallback when the profile is absent.
notes.camera: unchanged: link4 branch mount, no TCP migration.
notes.angle_source: Frozen by tools/g4a2r/validate_postures.py from a measured grid + j1 aiming search; never hand-guessed.

initial.note: identical to the G4A-1 baseline (model joint4=-1.5708 rad); historical behaviour preserved and verified bit-exact against arm_spec.

reference_initial_posture.finding: The G4A-1 baseline camera looks essentially horizontally with a low valid-depth fraction and the target cube out of frame - matches the operator complaint of sky/ground views.

search_space.aiming: fine j1 sweep 0.1 rad over the full joint1 range per fold, minimising cube distance from frame centre
search_space.criteria: joint limits, no self-collision, no arm-cube contact, depth valid fraction >= 0.5, pitch in [-50, +5] deg; stage 2 adds 3 s servo settle (base drift < 10 mm, tilt < 3 deg, reach error < 0.05 rad) and a 36-angle 360 deg sweep with zero collisions

code_changes: src/mobilecar/backends/mujoco/backend.py: posture profile loading, _apply_initial_posture, posture(), g4a2_postures in capabilities

regression.suites: tests/contracts tests/ui tests/g4a1 tests/g4a2 tests/integration tests/backend
regression.failure: tests/integration/test_provenance.py (documented contacts.py historical exception, untouched by this change)
regression.note: tests/ui require npm run build:ui in the release first (known build-order dependency); 6/6 pass after the build.

ui_buttons_deferred: Posture apply buttons and their send/accept/apply/reach feedback ship with Phase 3 (six-dimensional action chain); capabilities already expose the posture list.
